title: Shore Acres Park
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Shore Acres is a beautiful , scenic , quiet park that has a well maintained beautiful private sandy beach , that is run by a very friendly attentive staff . It's proximity to downtown port Dover means you can easily walk or bike to Dover's great restaurants and attractions . We are enjoying Shore Acres now (4 years) as our parents have done for the past 25 years.
